# openai_organization_spend_limit (Resource)

Manage the organization hard spend limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_organization_spend_limit" "example" {
  threshold_amount = 20
  currency         = "USD"
  interval         = "month"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `currency` (String) currency
- `interval` (String) interval
- `threshold_amount` (Number) threshold amount

### Read-Only

- `enforcement_status` (String) enforcement status
- `object` (String) object
- `singleton_id` (String) singleton id

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_organization_spend_limit.example
  id = "organization"
}
```
